title: nixos/rustical: fix unix domain socket support
watch_selection_basis: enable (baseline) only -- this PR's own diff to rustical.nix is confined to the systemd.services.rustical.serviceConfig hardening block (adds RuntimeDirectory/RuntimeDirectoryMode, adds AF_UNIX to RestrictAddressFamilies, changes UMask 0077->0007); it does not textually touch any mkOption/mkEnableOption declaration. Note for coordinator: the module also declares a nested settings.http.bind option (module.nix line 58, 'Address and port or UNIX socket path to bind the HTTP service to') which is conceptually what this PR's unix-socket fix concerns, but that option's own declaration line is not part of this PR's diff, so per the literal 'diff touches' rule it was not added to watch.
tool_invocation: audit-diff (module existed on both sides) + check on base-root and head-root to resolve 'unchanged' diff entries

identities.side: unchanged (PASS on both base and head, per oba check)

structural_notes: nixos/tests/web-apps/rustical.nix sets only services.rustical.enable = true; it reads (does not assign) config.services.rustical.settings.http.bind at nix-eval time in nginx's proxyPass and again in the testScript's wait_for_file call, relying on the module's own default for settings.http.bind rather than setting it explicitly.
